verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a Registrar API for searching/checking domain availability and support for 400+ TLDs with at-cost, no-markup pricing (docs-9, docs-10, docs-20), which reduces incentive for squatting, but there is no evidence of alternate-TLD suggestion UX, explicit anti-squatting guarantees, or hands-on confirmation of search speed/behavior. missing for 10: evidence of alternate-TLD suggestion feature, explicit no-squatting policy, and independent hands-on testing of the search flow.
